title: NDVI (STS) 2015-2019 (raster 1 km), global, 10-daily – version 3

### About
Based upon SPOT/VEGETATION and PROBA-V NDVI 1km version 2, long-term statistics include the minimum, median, maximum, mean, standard deviation and the number of observations over the 19-years period 1999-2017.

[View this dataset in Copernicus Browser](https://browser.dataspace.copernicus.eu/?zoom=9&lat=46.02622&lng=14.5253&themeId=DEFAULT-THEME&datasetId=COPERNICUS_CLMS_FAPAR_300M_10DAILY&fromTime=2014-01-01T00%3A00%3A00.000Z&toTime=2025-06-12T14:36:02.075893&layerId=FAPAR&demSource3D=%22MAPZEN%22&cloudCoverage=30&dateMode=SINGLE&clmsSelectedPath=Vegetation%20Properties&clmsSelectedCollection=COPERNICUS_CLMS_FAPAR_300M_10DAILY)
